properties.name: claims
properties.purpose: The coordination module: who has which region of the design in hand, and where two people are working the same ground. Advisory only — it holds no locks and refuses no writes, because the design lives as a file in each checkout with no shared server to hold one (dec:multi-writer-architecture). Regions are computed from a seed and a depth via the same traversal propagate_from uses, so they follow the design rather than freezing a membership list.
